jobs.title: Senior Copywriter — PR & Social Media
jobs.excerpt: Overview:SOFTSWISS is hiring a Senior Copywriter to join our PR Team.
jobs.description:
Overview:

SOFTSWISS is hiring a Senior Copywriter to join our PR Team. You’ll create PR and social media content that communicates our products, expertise and company news to external audiences across media, industry platforms and corporate channels.

Purpose of the Role:

Own the quality and delivery of written communications across PR and social media, turning business, product and brand inputs into clear, accurate and engaging external content. You’ll work closely with the PR and SMM teams while operating independently: understanding the objective behind each task, identifying missing information, working directly with relevant stakeholders, and bringing content to a publication-ready standard.

Key Responsibilities:

PR

  • Write and edit press releases, media announcements and other PR materials that clearly communicate company news and key messages.

  • Create thought-leadership articles, expert comments, interview materials and LinkedIn Pulse articles for company and external platforms.

  • Own the awards submission process, from maintaining the awards calendar and identifying opportunities to preparing submissions and coordinating stakeholder input.

  • Manage and update company profiles across relevant media platforms and industry directories.

  • Prepare executive presentations, talking points and supporting marketing materials in collaboration with internal experts.

  • Conduct independent research and fact-checking to ensure content is accurate, relevant and well-supported.

Social Media

  • Produce approximately 4–5 social media posts per week across agreed corporate channels.

  • Turn complex product, business and expert topics into clear, engaging and accessible social content.

  • Research topics, analyse data and collaborate with internal experts to uncover useful insights and stories.

  • Turn large volumes of information into concise, structured and engaging digests.

  • Adapt product updates, interviews, expert quotes and public-speaking materials into social-first formats.

  • Monitor events, awards, company news and media coverage to create timely digests with relevant context and analysis.

  • Support special social media projects with copy, messaging and editorial input.

Editorial Quality & Ownership

  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned content, from clarifying the brief and gathering input to fact-checking and delivering publication-ready copy.

  • Apply strong editorial judgement to identify weak messaging, factual gaps and unsupported claims before final review.

  • Maintain consistency in messaging, terminology and tone of voice across external communications.

  • Work autonomously from idea development and research through final copy and delivery.

  • Create editorial content around defined topics and priorities, including content designed to improve visibility in search and LLM-driven discovery.

Required Experience:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in copywriting, journalism, PR writing or editorial work.

  • Excellent written English, ideally at C1+ or near-native level.

  • Russian at C1+ level.

  • Strong writing and editing skills across multiple content formats.

  • Strong research and fact-checking skills.

  • Experience working independently with internal experts and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong editorial judgement and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple content streams and deadlines simultaneously.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in B2B technology, iGaming or another complex industry.

  • Professional experience covering both PR and social media content.

  • Good understanding of social media formats, post structure and platform mechanics.

Our Benefits:

  • Private health insurance

  • Sports benefits

  • Comprehensive Mental Health Program

  • Free English lessons (online)

  • Local language courses

  • Paid time off

  • Maternity leave support

  • Referral program rewards

  • Upskilling, internal workshops, and participation in professional conferences and corporate events

Join Henry Schein One!

Join a global leader redefining dental practice management and do work that actually matters. At Henry Schein One, we are a team of care catalysts: people who fuel innovation, challenge the status quo, and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to everything we do. Your ideas fuel innovation that enhances patient care and drives real results for practices.

Here, your strengths are recognized, your development matters, and your wins celebrated. 

As a Telecom Engineer you help power the communication platforms that keep our business connected. You'll provide frontline support for NICE CXone, RingCentral, and next-generation cloud voice solutions, resolving technical issues, maintaining telecom workflows, and assisting with call flow design and implementation. Working closely with senior engineers and business stakeholders, you'll contribute to system enhancements, operational excellence, and continuous improvement while developing expertise in modern cloud contact center and telecom technologies and making a direct impact on both employee and customer experiences through reliable, innovative communication solutions.

This position is remote within the United States with up to 10% travel as needed.

What You Will Do
  • Provide Tier 1 support for RingCentral and NICE CXone environments, resolving issues related to user access, call quality, device configuration, routing errors, IVR functionality, and other telecom-related incidents
  • Provision and manage user accounts, roles, and system configurations while monitoring platform health, system alerts, queue performance, and routing behavior
  • Perform initial incident triage and troubleshooting using telecom diagnostic tools and dashboards, documenting findings and escalating complex issues to Tier 2/3 engineering teams with complete case details
  • Assist with the development, modification, testing, validation, and documentation of call flows within NICE CXone Studio and RingCentral administration platforms
  • Maintain accurate change records, version control, support documentation, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base content to support ongoing operational excellence
  • Partner with senior telecom engineers during system implementations, major deployments, and high-volume support periods to ensure service stability and performance
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand operational requirements, align telecom configurations with business needs, and communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical users
What We Are Looking For
  • 3+ years of experience in IT or telecom support roles
  • Hands-on experience with NICE CXone and RingCentral platforms
  • Familiarity with IVRs, call routing, user provisioning, and basic telecom workflows
  • Exposure to scripting or workflow tools (CXone Studio preferred
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities while maintaining high levels of service and support
  • Demonstrate ownership and accountability by driving issues through resolution and following up with vendors and stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills and attention to detail
What Will Set You Apart
  • Associate’s Degree in Information Technology or a related field
  • Training or certifications on RingCentral or NICE CXOne
  • Basic scripting knowledge (e.g., XML, JavaScript, Snippet)
  • Proficient in SIP ladder analysis and troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting and administering Amazon Connect and Salesforce Service Cloud Voice environments, including call routing, contact flows, user configuration, softphone troubleshooting, unified CRM-telephony operations, and cross-platform issue resolution
  • Knowledge of Salesforce Omni-Channel Routing, Voice Call Objects, CTI integrations, and Agentforce Voice capabilities, including AI-powered voice automation that enhances contact center operations, real-time customer interactions, and agent productivity

The posted range for this position is $73,000 - $95,000, which is the expected starting salary range for an employee who is new to the role to fully proficient in the role. Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including prior experience, current skills, location/labor market, internal equity, etc.This position is eligible for a bonus target not reflected in the range.

A robust benefits package including health coverage, retirement savings with company match, paid time off, parental leave, wellbeing resources, education support, and MORE!

jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

People come to TopDog Law at one of the hardest moments of their lives: injured, overwhelmed, and unsure of what comes next. They need someone in their corner who knows their name, understands their situation, and is actively fighting to get them the best possible outcome. The Case Manager exists to be that person, a dedicated advocate who owns the client relationship completely and ensures no one ever feels like just a file number. When this role is done right, clients feel heard, supported, and confident that someone is genuinely working for them.

What You Will Own

  • Own the client relationship from day one through settlement, the Welcome Call is yours, the relationship is yours, and the outcome is yours
  • Be the client's dedicated advocate, connecting them to the right care fast and walking them through one of the most stressful experiences of their life with confidence and compassion
  • Drive cases forward with urgency, moving through each phase with precision and purpose
  • Build demand packages that tell a compelling story and negotiate toward outcomes that make a real difference for real people
  • Be the source of truth on every case you touch, leveraging cutting-edge technology to stay sharp, move fast, and never let anything slip
  • This is not a hand-off role, it's full ownership, and for the right person, it's one of the most impactful seats in the firm

What You Bring

Required:

  • 2–6 years of experience supporting Personal Injury pre-litigation matters on cases in Arkansas
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience requesting, reviewing, and summarizing medical records and bills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently while collaborating with a team

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Bachelor's degree or Paralegal Certificate
  • Experience in a high-volume or fast-growing law firm
  • Familiarity with Personal Injury claims processes and insurance procedures
  • Experience with case management software (e.g., Filevine, Clio, SmartAdvocate)
  • Comfort working in evolving systems and processes

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

CrowdStrike is looking for a hands-on AWS threat hunter with strong technical and analytical skills, genuine curiosity about cloud attack techniques, experience hunting for evidence of adversarial activity, and the ability to develop defensive capabilities to counter them. The ideal candidate will have 3-5 years of hands-on threat hunting experience in cloud environments, preferably AWS.

You will work with complex, high-profile organizations across the globe, conducting threat hunting in cloud environments to identify active and historical threats, reviewing cloud control plane configurations, and providing technical recommendations to reduce adversary opportunity in target environments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Utilize the Falcon platform and threat intelligence to analyze cloud logs and identify historical and active threats.

  • Baseline and review cloud security configurations, looking for anomalies associated with threat activity.

  • Develop queries and scripts to work with large volumes of data, including correlating data across multiple sources and identifying outliers that may be indicative of threat activity.

  • Identify identity and control plane configurations that may expose cloud environments to threats and unauthorized access.

  • Produce high-quality written and verbal reports, presentations, recommendations, and findings for key stakeholders, including customer management, regulators, and legal counsel.

Technical Skills:

  • A solid grasp of AWS security architecture patterns, including log management architecture and automation patterns leveraging AWS-native services.

  • A strong knowledge of security configuration and architecture of CI/CD pipelines

  • A strong ability to write modular scripts and software tools in Python or Go to work with AWS services and Falcon APs.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Communication Skills:

  • A strong ability to verbally communicate technical concepts and findings in plain English to technical and non-technical audiences, including CISO-level stakeholders.

We care about what you know and what you can do, not the specific path you took to get here. Strong candidates will have built real depth in cloud platforms and security over time - whether through years in dedicated security roles, a background in cloud engineering or DevOps that shifted toward threat hunting, or any other route that got them to the same place. About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Manager to join our global business.

Reporting directly to the General Manager of Southern Europe and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and strategic partners, you will be 100% focused on driving new business growth and expanding Fresha's presence across the region.

This is a remote role, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a high-growth territory while helping to accelerate Fresha's expansion. You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and engaging beauty and wellness businesses in your region, combining proactive field sales activity with a consultative approach to build strong local relationships and drive commercial success.

This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, enjoys working autonomously, embraces challenges, and wants to make a tangible impact on the growth of a leading global technology platform.

  • Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (in-person meetings as appropriate)

  • Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives

What we are looking for

  • Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively

Added bonus

  • Bi-lingual - Fluency in Spanish and another language - preferably Basque

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer - Remote (Americas time zones)
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Why this role existsSell2Rent is a fast-growing residential real estate platform specializing in sale-leaseback transactions.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Why this role exists

Sell2Rent is a fast-growing residential real estate platform specializing in sale-leaseback transactions. We help homeowners unlock their home equity without moving, while connecting properties with single-family rental investors. We operate in 30+ states and have closed 200+ transactions.

Technology is a key driver of our growth. We’ve built a proprietary operating platform, AI agents for lead qualification and outreach, an investor-matching layer, and a lead engine that supports our sales process.

We’re looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) who sees technology as a growth and revenue engine — not just an engineering function. You’ll work closely with Sales, and Marketing, to use AI, automation, data, and product to generate more qualified leads, improve conversion, accelerate the sales cycle, and close more transactions.

You’ll inherit real, revenue-generating technology, a talented team, and the opportunity to create the technology strategy that will help Sell2Rent scale faster and sell more.

If you’re excited about using technology to drive measurable business results, this is your opportunity to make a major impact.

What you'll own

Technology strategy.You set the direction: architecture, build-vs-buy, which platforms we standardize on, where AI is a genuine advantage and where it's a distraction. You'll be the person in the room who knows what's actually possible and what it costs.

The engineering organization.You lead a distributed team of roughly ten across engineering and data, all of them in Latin America. You'll grow it, structure it, and set the bar.

Scaling the platform.Our twelve-month mandate is to ship the roadmap and scale what we've built — completing the migration off legacy systems, hardening the platform, and getting to a place where the business can grow transaction volume without engineering becoming the bottleneck.

The AI layer.Agents handle a meaningful share of our qualification, outreach, and internal operations today. Deciding how far that goes — and building it so it's a durable advantage rather than a demo — is one of the most interesting problems here.

Resilience and continuity.Security, access governance, vendor management, monitoring, documentation, and the discipline that ensures no single person is ever again the only one who knows how something works. We've learned this lesson the expensive way and we're not repeating it.

Executive partnership.You sit on the Executive Committee. You'll work directly with the CEO and the sales, marketing, and operations leaders — translating what the business needs into what gets built, and telling us honestly when what we're asking for is a bad idea.


Requirements

Who we're looking for

  • 15+ years in technology, with progressive leadership responsibility and time as a CTO, VP of Engineering, or Head of Technology.

  • You've scaled a team and a system before.Not just managed one — took something from working-but-fragile to reliable-at-volume, and grew the org that did it.

  • You are technical enough to be trusted, but your job is not to write the code.You should be able to read our architecture, challenge a design decision, and evaluate a vendor on the merits. We have engineers to build. We need someone who can direct them and know when the answer is wrong.

  • Real depth in AI-driven architecture, cloud infrastructure (we run on GCP), APIs, integrations, and data. Depth, not enthusiasm — you can tell us what LLM-based agents actually break on in production.

  • You find blind spots.Much of the value in your first six months is telling us what we don't know we're missing — in our architecture, our tooling, our security posture, and our process.

  • You lead people well.Our team is remote, distributed, and international. Keeping engineers motivated, growing, and clear on what matters is a large part of this job.

  • Startup-fluent.You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and making decisions before all the information arrives.

  • Business-minded.You can connect a technical investment to revenue and defend it to a CEO who will ask.

Helpful, not required:real estate, proptech, or fintech experience; running a US-based company with a LatAm engineering team; Spanish.

How this role fits with product

Our CEO owns product direction and will continue to for the foreseeable future, working closely with the commercial leadership team. You own technology, architecture, and execution. You'll have real influence on what we build and strong input on sequencing — but the product roadmap is not yours to set, and we're not planning to hand it over.

We're stating this plainly because the previous version of this role blended both, and the wrong expectation here makes an otherwise great partnership fail. If owning a product is what you're looking for in your next role, this isn't it.

What success looks like

By 90 days— you know where every system, credential, vendor, and dependency lives, and so does someone besides you. You've told us the three things about our architecture that worry you most. The team knows who they report to, what they're building, and why it matters.

By 6 months— the platform migration is on a credible path, engineering has a real operating cadence, and technology decisions are being made deliberately rather than reactively. You've made at least one hire that raises the bar.

By 12 months— we've shipped the roadmap, the platform handles significantly more volume without more people, and our AI capability is a genuine competitive advantage rather than a set of internal tools. Nothing critical depends on any single individual, including you.


Benefits

Details

  • Location:Remote, with meaningful overlap with US Eastern and Latin America.

  • Compensation:Competitive base plus meaningful equity. We'll be direct about the range early in the process.

  • Team:~10 in technology and data; company-wide, a lean and fast-moving organization.

Our process

  1. Intro call with the CEO — 45 minutes, mutual fit.

  2. Technical and architectural conversation — we'll walk you through what we've actually built and get your honest read on it.

  3. Meet the engineering team and two executive peers.

  4. A working session on a real problem we're facing. Paid, if it requires meaningful preparation.

  5. References and offer.

We move quickly and we'll tell you where you stand at every step.

Sell2Rent is an equal opportunity employer.

Job Summary:

We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Product team.
You will be the connective tissue between business needs and product execution, translating stakeholder requirements into clear, actionable specifications that enable our Development, Design, and Quality Assurance teams to deliver valuable product outcomes.
Working closely with Product Managers, you will bring structure, clarity, and momentum to product delivery, freeing Product Managers to focus on strategy, discovery and product direction.
AI will be an important part of how you work. You will use Claude and other AI tools to accelerate high-volume activities such as drafting requirements, synthesizing feedback, identifying gaps, generating test scenarios, and preparing release documentation. You will direct the tools, critically evaluate their outputs, and remain fully accountable for everything shared with Development teams and stakeholders.
Make your impact with a rapidly growing marine software business.

Job Description:

You Will

  • Elicit, document, analyze, and validate business requirements through stakeholder interviews, working sessions, research, and product discovery activities.
    - Use Claude and other AI tools to accelerate first-draft documentation while independently reviewing, refining, and validating all outputs.
    - Translate business and customer needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and measurable acceptance criteria.
    - Maintain a groomed backlog with PM partnership; use Claude for gap detection before tickets reach development.
    - Document current-state and future-state workflows, business rules, system behaviour, and product interactions to create alignment before development begins.
    - Act as trusted point of contact for scope, timelines, and delivery status; facilitate working sessions across business, product, and development.
    - Communicate changes, decisions, and rationale clearly - no one should be surprised.
    - Develop test scenarios for QA/UAT using Claude-generated drafts from acceptance criteria; track delivery against those criteria and escalate gaps.
    - Analyze product usage, support tickets, and stakeholder feedback to inform prioritization; build lightweight reporting for stakeholders and leadership.
    - Coordinate release notes using AI; partner with product marketing to enable internal teams before new capabilities ship.

You Bring

  • Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Product Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or in a similar role within a software or technology environment.
    - Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft 365.
    - Practical experience using Claude or comparable generative AI tools in a professional environment.
    - The ability to write effective prompts, evaluate AI-generated content, recognize inaccurate or incomplete outputs, and edit artifacts to a high professional standard.
    - Solid PDLC understanding; ability to read data via Excel, SQL, or BI platforms; comfortable in technical discussions without being a developer.
    - A solid understanding of how software products are built and how feature decisions connect to business outcomes (revenue, retention, operational efficiency).
    - Exceptional written and verbal communication - increasingly means editing AI-generated artifacts to a high standard.
    - Strong facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to align teams that may have different priorities or perspectives.
    - Experience working simultaneously across Product Management, Development, Design, Quality Assurance, and business stakeholders.
    - The confidence to respectfully challenge stakeholder requests, uncover the underlying need, and determine whether the proposed solution is addressing the right problem.
    - A critical mindset and the ability to apply the same level of scrutiny to AI-generated outputs as you would to any other source of information.
    - The ability to work effectively through ambiguity while remaining organized, proactive, and focused on outcomes.

A CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, or equivalent certification would be an asset. Demonstrated experience using Claude or other generative AI tools within a professional product or technology environment is valued alongside traditional qualifications.

Who You Are

You are goal-oriented, self-motivated, curious, and a clear communicator.

You take ownership of your work from initial conversation through delivery and validation. You approach ambiguity with curiosity and rigour, ask thoughtful questions, and are not afraid to challenge assumptions when doing so will lead to a better outcome.

You use AI confidently and responsibly - not as a replacement for judgment, but as a tool to work faster and more effectively. You know how to direct, assess, edit, and quality-check AI-generated content rather than treating the first output as finished work.

Most importantly, you care about helping teams build the right solutions, not simply documenting what you have been asked to build.

Role is open to candidates based in Africa only.

Amid increasing disruptions to global supply chains and shifts in the global aid financing landscape, the Senior Supply Chain Advisor (SSCA) will provide strategic leadership to help ensure reliable access to safe abortion commodities, contraceptives, and gender-based violence management supplies across development and humanitarian contexts. This role will strengthen supply availability through formal health systems and self-care pathways by establishing and enhancing global technical tools, processes, monitoring mechanisms, and partnerships that contribute to a sustainable abortion ecosystem. Effective supply chain management is a critical pillar for building resilient, responsive, and equitable pathways to care.

Summary of Responsibilities

The SSCA serve as subject matter expert for global health supply chain technical issues, in areas such as quantification, forecasting, procurement, storage and distribution and inventory management, logistics management information systems (LMIS), health systems strengthening, budgeting and financial management, driving and analyzing supply chain performance, and program effectiveness.

The role is expected to translate technical expertise into practical tools, country support, and partnership strategies that reduce supply interruptions and improve visibility, availability, and responsible use of reproductive health commodities.

Organizational Leadership and Strategy:

  • Lead the Ipas supply chain management approach across the network by ensuring that evidence and best practice inform strategies and efforts to sustain the availability of abortion and contraception drugs across the different pathways to care.

Program, technical, and functional responsibilities:

  • Provide technical leadership and support to strengthen sexual and reproductive health commodity supply chains at global, regional, and country levels across the pathways to care
  • Support countries to assess gaps in reproductive health commodity systems and implement corrective actions.
  • Improve forecasting, quantification, procurement, warehousing, distribution, transportation, quality assurance, and logistics management information systems for abortion and contraception commodities.
  • Design and optimize supply chain strategies, tools, and frameworks for SRH commodities in partnership with country programs, governments, and partners to speed up product flow.
  • Build national capacity through training, mentoring, curricula development, and knowledge transfer for supply chain staff and stakeholders.
  • Strengthen partnerships with national, regional, and international experts, institutions, and partner organizations to advance RH supply chain systems.
  • Promote evidence-based approaches, lessons learned, innovation, and increase data visibility and use for continuous improvement of supply chain performance and operations.
  • Establish quality assurance, sustainability assessment, monitoring, evaluation frameworks, and KPIs to track supply chain performance globally.
  • Mitigate supply chain disruptions through risk management, contingency planning, supplier diversification, and compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Foster innovation in procurement, market shaping, inventory management, distribution, and technology-enabled global stock management, including in crisis-affected settings.
  • Contribute to the regional advocacy efforts to integrate abortion commodities in essential medicine lists (EML), including supporting the registration and marketing authorization of abortion commodities.
  • Capitalize on private sector supply chain capacity and knowledge for innovative packaging, distribution, and user experience documentation.
  • Lead monitoring and evidence synthesis on the safety and quality of abortion commodities used locally in order to contribute to external collective efforts of pharmacovigilance.

Resource mobilization:

  • Contribute to project design, proposal development, and opportunity prospecting for supply chain strengthening initiatives.
  • Participate in donor and partner calls to ensure supply chain needs, priorities, and progress are effectively represented across the Ipas network.
  • Assist procurement and contracting team with product quality assurance assessments and vendor certification vetting.
  • Coordinate and support financial review of global supply chain strengthening initiatives and projects

Communications & representation:

  • Lead efforts to highlight, advance, and advocate for abortion supply planning priorities by engaging supply chain coalitions and working groups, international NGOs, multilateral partners—including UN agencies, the World Bank Group, WHO—and donors to collaborate on and inform global abortion supply planning.
  • Contribute to evidence generation and knowledge sharing on reproductive health supply chains across countries, regional networks, technical forums, and international conferences.

Position Requirements

  • Deep commitment to sexual and reproductive health and rights, especially abortion and contraception access
  • Significant experience in key areas of supply chain system assessment approaches and tools, forecasting and quantification methods and tools, procurement processes, inventory control and distribution systems, and management information systems.
  • Experience working with private sector partners, including pharmacies, community distribution systems, and digital health platforms.
  • Professional-level fluency in English
  • Proven ability to lead and motivate teams and foster a positive work environment through supportive supervision, effective communication, shared leadership, and modeling of organizational core values.
  • Demonstrated capacity and commitment to sound stewardship of funds, including strong skills in work planning, budgeting, financial monitoring, and data-driven problem solving.
  • Proven ability to build positive working relationships with diverse internal teams and external partners.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and sound judgment skills, with the ability to identify and resolve policy and operational constraints.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent knowledge of and experience working with country and/or regional health system entities.

Education

Advanced degree (master’s or equivalent) in public health, supply chain management, logistics, health system strengthening, pharmacy, or related medical field

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in global health supply chain management, with a strong focus on reproductive health commodity supply chains.
  • Strong quantitative analysis and forecasting skills, cross-cultural diplomacy, and experience working in low-resource or humanitarian settings.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical assistance to global health programs.
  • Demonstrated experience in global health commodity supply chain management.
  • Knowledge of technical issues related to global health commodity procurement.
  • Demonstrated ability in strategic planning, program management, and implementation in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Experience working on sustainable commodity access programs.
  • Experience facilitating training and providing technical assistance to country teams, including through remote support

Ipas is a globally networked organization committed to shared leadership and local ownership. 67% of our leadership are women, and our teams are grounded in local expertise and lived experience. Equity is not an add-on — it drives how we design programs and how we work as an organization.

ABOUT US AND ABOUT YOU

Clinician Nexus enables health care organizations to build thriving clinician teams with industry-leading technology products, workforce and compensation analytics, and automated workflow solutions. As a Data Platform Engineer your core responsibility revolves around crafting, advancing, and maintaining the infrastructure and systems essential for managing and optimizing data as an enterprise asset. In this capacity, you will create and maintain tooling, abstractions, and services that allow enterprise users to meticulously oversee the entire lifecycle of their data product, encompassing the efficient collection, storage, processing, and retrieval of data, all while upholding stringent standards for security, governance, and data quality. You will possess extensive expertise in working with diverse data storage technologies, including databases, data lakes, and data warehouses, as well as streaming architectures and service layer technologies. You are proficient in programming languages such as Python, Scala, Java, and SQL. Your skillset extends to encompass data integration, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, ELT (Extract, Load, Transform), Restful/GRPC services, Streaming, and the construction and abstraction of robust data pipelines. The overarching objective as a Data Platform Engineer is to enable enterprise product teams to deliver quality data products that drive business insight and value to our customers. Job Description

The Technology Architecture Lead is responsible for designing, building, and governing a scalable, AI-enabled platform for developing, managing, and maintaining training and enablement content. This role serves as the technical architect for SharePoint-based ecosystems and associated AI capabilities, ensuring content is structured, discoverable, governed, and continuously optimized across global commercial and learning organizations.

The role bridges information architecture, platform design, and applied AI to create a modern content system that improves speed to market, content quality, reuse, and compliance. Working closely with enablement, L&D, IT, and business stakeholders, the architect translates content strategy and governance requirements into a sustainable technical solution.

Key Responsibilities

Platform & Information Architecture

  • Design and own the end-to-end architecture for SharePoint-based training and enablement content platforms.

  • Define site structures, taxonomies, metadata models, permissions, and lifecycle management standards to support global content needs.

  • Ensure the platform supports scalability, usability, and consistent user experience across regions and teams.

AI-Enabled Content Systems

  • Apply AI capabilities (e.g., content tagging, search optimization, summarization, recommendations, and content quality insights) to improve how training content is created, curated, and consumed.

  • Partner with internal teams and vendors to integrate AI services with SharePoint and related content systems.

  • Translate business needs into practical AI use cases that improve content effectiveness and governance.

Content Governance & Standards

  • Establish and enforce governance frameworks for content creation, review, approval, versioning, and retirement.

  • Define technical guardrails and workflows that support compliance, accuracy, and consistency of training materials.

  • Partner with enablement and L&D leaders to align platform design with instructional and commercial standards.

Implementation & Integration

  • Lead technical implementation and configuration of SharePoint sites, workflows, and integrations with adjacent systems (e.g., LMS, CRM, enablement platforms).

  • Collaborate with IT to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and data management requirements.

  • Manage technical dependencies and integration points across the content ecosystem.

Stakeholder Enablement & Adoption

  • Enable content owners, authors, and administrators through guidance, templates, and best practices for using the platform.

  • Develop documentation, playbooks, and onboarding materials to support adoption and correct usage.

A big part of this role is operational clarity. You'll create the reporting and dashboards that surface where work is flowing and where it's stuck, then act on what you see. You'll push your team toward standardization — fewer one-off approaches, more templates and repeatable systems that preserve quality at scale. When something goes sideways with a customer, you step in.

You'll also work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales — translating implementation learnings into product feedback and coordinating across teams to solve problems that don't stay in one lane.

Expect to:

  • Own planning, scoping, and resourcing across active customer implementations

  • Manage and coach a team of Implementation Leads and Specialists, with clear goals and accountability to results

  • Build and maintain reporting on plan throughput, QA/QC ratings, milestone achievement, and team capacity

  • Identify inefficiencies in how the team works and drive adoption of better, more standardized approaches

  • Serve as the escalation owner when customer implementations are at risk — and see them through to resolution

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to surface learnings and improve execution

  • Travel up to 20% for customer on-sites and company retreats

About You

You're a leader who gets things done through clarity, not just effort. You've managed implementation or project teams in complex environments and you know that true success isn't plan delivery — it's adoption. You set high expectations for your team and for yourself, and you're willing to get into the details when that's what it takes to clear a blocker.

You thrive when there's ambiguity to structure. You don't wait to be handed a playbook — you build one, test it, and improve it. You're as comfortable presenting to leadership as you are working through a thorny process problem with your team. And you have enough technical depth in BIM and construction workflows to earn credibility with the people you manage and the builders you serve.

You have:

  • 5+ years using BIM software and/or leading implementation or project teams in tech, construction, or homebuilding software

  • Proven experience managing people and running complex, fast-moving customer onboarding projects

  • A track record of building and using team performance metrics — throughput, quality, efficiency — to drive real improvement

  • Hands-on knowledge of CAD/BIM tools (Revit, AutoCAD, or similar) and homebuilding or construction workflows

  • Strong instincts for spotting inefficiency and the follow-through to actually fix it

  • A bias toward action and a willingness to challenge how things have always been done

  • Clear, confident communication style with high expectations — for your team and yourself

Working at Higharc

Higharc has been remote first since our founding in 2018. We offer flexible hours so you can do your best work without missing out on life. Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company.

Personal healthiness is an important value for us- we provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. Haven't worked remotely before? We provide a stipend to create the ideal home office.

World Fuel is looking for an experienced and solution-oriented Senior Logistics Coordinator to join our National Transport team. If you enjoy solving transportation challenges, coordinating complex logistics operations, collaborating with multiple stakeholders, and driving operational excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Senior Logistics Coordinator, you'll play a critical role in ensuring fuel deliveries are executed safely, efficiently, and on time. You'll serve as a key point of contact for drivers, customers, carriers, suppliers, and internal teams while managing transportation operations and resolving challenges in real time.

In addition to coordinating daily dispatch activities, you'll help improve operational performance, support transportation decision-making, resolve escalated service issues, and serve as a resource for less experienced team members.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced logistics professional who enjoys balancing customer service, transportation planning, operational execution, and problem-solving in a fast-paced environment.

What You'll Do

Coordinate Transportation Operations

  • Analyze customer fuel delivery requirements and inventory levels to ensure timely fulfillment.
  • Build and manage daily dispatch schedules while maximizing delivery efficiency.
  • Coordinate transportation activities with drivers, carriers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Assign loads to third-party carriers and ensure timely acceptance and execution.
  • Partner with Supply teams to identify optimal sourcing and lift-point strategies.
  • Lead recovery efforts for complex transportation and service-related challenges.

Support Customers & Carriers

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for transportation-related inquiries and escalations.
  • Provide exceptional customer service through proactive communication and issue resolution.
  • Coordinate closely with drivers and carriers to ensure deliveries are completed safely and on schedule.
  • Anticipate service disruptions and implement recovery solutions.
  • Balance customer expectations with operational efficiency and service commitments.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Make informed decisions in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.
  • Monitor transportation performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Support initiatives that improve service, efficiency, profitability, and customer experience.
  • Assist with operational reporting and transportation analytics.
  • Ensure compliance with DOT regulations, hazardous materials requirements, and company policies.
  • Report and document accidents, spills, and safety-related incidents.

Support Team Success

  • Serve as a resource and escalation point for less experienced team members.
  • Assist with onboarding, training, and coaching activities.
  • Share best practices and support operational consistency across the team.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and process enhancements.

What Makes You Successful

We're looking for someone who combines strong logistics expertise with excellent communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills & Competencies

  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Ability to prioritize effectively and manage competing deadlines.
  • Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Ability to make effective decisions under pressure.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently.
  • Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong computer proficiency and comfort working with multiple systems and applications.
  • Working knowledge of DOT regulations, hazardous materials requirements, and transportation operations.

Qualifications

Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of dispatching, transportation, logistics, supply chain, fleet operations, carrier operations, fuel transportation, or related operational experience.
  • Experience coordinating transportation activities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Knowledge of DOT regulations and transportation operations.

Preferred

  • Experience in petroleum, fuel transportation, dispatching, logistics, or supply chain operations.
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field.
  • Experience monitoring operational performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience training, mentoring, or supporting other team members.

Why World Fuel?

At World Fuel, you'll join a team that keeps essential industries moving. You'll work alongside experienced logistics professionals, contribute to critical energy supply operations, and play a key role in supporting transportation performance across our network.

As a Senior Logistics Coordinator, you'll help solve complex transportation challenges, support operational excellence, and influence outcomes that impact our customers, drivers, and business every day. This role offers opportunities to expand your logistics expertise, develop leadership skills, and grow within a global organization committed to innovation, safety, and customer service.

If you're ready to take the next step in your logistics career and make an impact in a role that combines transportation operations, customer service, problem-solving, and leadership, we'd love to meet you.

Apply today and help power what's next.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on coach who thrives in a fast-paced SaaS startup environment. The team reports directly to the President of the Provider Solutions division, and you should expect to work with and present to executive management often.

This is a senior individual contributor role, not a people management position. The other data scientists do not report to you. You lead through influence by setting technical direction on projects, coaching and raising the bar for your peers, and setting the example on the hardest problems. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in natural language processing (NLP), hands on experience with large language models (LLMs), and fluency with event driven data pipelines. Software engineering experience is a plus because you will work closely with our engineers.

What you will work on

  • Own AI, ML, and NLP initiatives end to end, from problem framing through model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and long term maintenance in production.
  • Apply LLMs to automate complex, high volume workflows. Partner with software architects and engineering to deliver solutions that meet strict platform latency and throughput requirements across millions of transactions, balancing accuracy, response time, and inference cost through model selection, caching, and prompt design.
  • Define what good looks like. Build evaluation datasets and automated eval pipelines for LLM and ML systems, measure quality and error rates on clinical and financial content, and catch regressions when prompts, models, or data change.

  • Partner with clinicians, pharmacists, and other domain experts to define ground truth, adjudicate edge cases, and validate that model behavior holds up against real clinical workflows.
  • Ensure solutions are accurate, robust, and compliant with healthcare regulations including HIPAA, with appropriate handling of PHI and monitoring for bias, safety, and performance drift.
  • Act as the technical lead on projects. Set direction, define approach, establish best practices, and influence technical strategy on complex, high ambiguity problems.
  • Coach and mentor data scientists through pairing, design and code reviews, and constructive feedback. Contribute to hiring by interviewing and helping raise the technical bar of the team.
  • Communicate complex analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences, including executive management, through clear presentations, reports, and visualizations.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, and NLP, with a track record of delivering models into production.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Pipeline development and orchestration. Hands on experience building ELT and ETL workflows with tools such as dbt, Airflow, and AWS data services (Glue, DMS, Lambda, S3), with attention to incremental loads, idempotency, data quality testing, and documentation and lineage.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including tested, modular, production quality Python, Git based workflows and code review, containerization (Docker), and CI/CD.
  • Experience productionizing and monitoring models on AWS, including model registry, CI/CD for ML, versioning, and post deployment monitoring, with tools such as SageMaker and MLflow.
  • Experience building and evaluating LLM powered applications, for example Claude via Amazon Bedrock, including prompt design, retrieval and RAG pipelines, and systematic evaluation of output quality.
  • Proven ability to scope ambiguous problems and deliver solutions end to end with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects and coach or mentor other data scientists, guiding technical decisions and elevating team output.
  • Excellent problem solving and communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the healthcare or insurance industry.
  • Healthcare data literacy across FHIR, HL7v2, and X12, and clinical vocabularies including RxNorm, NDC, ICD-10, and SNOMED.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining production data pipelines. This includes modeling data for an analytical warehouse (Amazon Redshift or a comparable columnar MPP platform), extracting from transactional systems (PostgreSQL), and writing performant SQL against large tables, including the ability to read a query plan and fix a slow query rather than escalate it.
  • Comfortable packaging and deploying work in containers (Docker) and deploying models to cloud managed serving infrastructure such as SageMaker endpoints, ECS, or Lambda. Familiarity with Kubernetes is a plus.

CRM Integration Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: CRM Integration Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a CRM Integration Architect to design and govern integrations between Salesforce and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on integration architecture, middleware selection, API strategy, and event-driven patterns that connect Salesforce reliably with ERP, data, marketing, and operational systems. The ideal candidate has architected Salesforce integration solutions at meaningful scale and brings deep familiarity with both Salesforce-native and enterprise middleware approaches. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the end-to-end integration architecture for Salesforce ecosystems spanning Sales, Service, Marketing, and Industry Clouds.
  • Select and apply appropriate integration patterns including request-reply, fire-and-forget, batch, and event-driven approaches.
  • Design integrations using Salesforce-native capabilities (Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Connect, Composite APIs) alongside enterprise middleware such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Lead integration design reviews and approve technical designs across Salesforce programs.
  • Define API strategy, contract management, and versioning standards for Salesforce-related integrations.
  • Architect data synchronization patterns for high-volume integrations with ERP, billing, and operational systems.
  • Design identity and access patterns for Salesforce integrations including OAuth flows and connected app management.
  • Establish error handling, retry, and dead-letter strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Drive performance, scalability, and governor-limit management for integration-heavy Salesforce implementations, designing patterns that stay safely within platform limits even as transaction volumes grow over time.
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure integrations meet enterprise security requirements.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Collaborate closely with vendors to evaluate and onboard integration platforms, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Stay current with Salesforce integration capabilities and broader iPaaS evolution.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of Salesforce experience, with significant time on complex integrations.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns and enterprise application architecture.
  • Experience designing data synchronization strategies with ERP and operational systems.
  • Strong understanding of identity, OAuth, and integration security.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Salesforce Certified Integration Architect credential.
  • Track record of leading large Salesforce integration programs.
Preferred Qualifications
  • MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect.
  • Experience with event-driven integration platforms (Kafka, Solace, Confluent).
  • Familiarity with Industry Clouds and their data-integration nuances.
  • Exposure to high-volume integration scenarios (10M+ records/day).
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite ERP systems.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Architect (GenAI, AWS)
jobs.excerpt: About the role:Provectus is a Premier AWS partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner at the forefront of applied AI, helping enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements.
jobs.description:
About the role:

    Provectus is a Premier AWS partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner at the forefront of applied AI, helping enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide and are obsessed with reimagining how they operate and compete.

    Our work centers on two verticals — Financial Services & Insurance and Healthcare & Life Sciences — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture.

    We embed engineers and leaders inside client operations as Forward Deployed Architects (FDA) and Forward Deployed Executives (FDX) — people who learn the work, ship the system, and own the outcome. Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Bluprints.

    You will do the customer’s job before you automate it.

    Most AI engagements fail the same way: someone gathers requirements, someone writes a PRD, and a team ships a workflow nobody uses. We think the requirements-gathering step is the bug. So we remove it.

    A Forward Deployed AI Engineer at Provectus spends the first weeks of an engagement in the operator’s seat — as the underwriter, the analyst, the RCM specialist, the claims clinician, whoever actually does the work we’ve been asked to change. You do the job. You learn the constraints from the inside, the ones nobody writes down. Then you sit at a table with that operator and a Forward Deployed Executive and rebuild the function from first principles — and you are the one who builds it.

    Three things define how you work:

  • Embedded, not engaged. You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it.
  • Real tasks, not scope. You are not fenced into a siloed deliverable. You go where the operating problem is.
  • Autonomous. Embedded is not staff-augmented. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket.

    • You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. That loop is the difference between an outcome and an invoice.

    You’ll be measured on whether the Business Unit’s number moved — not on hours, not on scope delivered.

    This is a role for engineers who have led before — as a founder, a CTO, a staff engineer — and who want to stay in the code while owning the outcome. On most days you’ll be the most senior technical person in the room, and you’ll still be the one shipping.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands-on today and intend to stay that way.
  • You will take the operator’s seat. You are genuinely willing to spend weeks doing someone else’s job — claims processing, underwriting, revenue-cycle work — before you write a line of code. Engineers who need to stay in the IDE should not apply.
  • You learn domains fast. Demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly enough to argue with the people who do it for a living.
  • Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works.
  • You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack.
  • Cloud-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus): containers, Kubernetes/ECS, IaC, CI/CD, and the operational reality of a system someone else inherits.
  • Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job.
  • Solid AI/ML foundations — you understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes, not just call the API.
  • Strong hands-on prodcution experience with Claude Code/Cowork.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

    • Nice to have:

  • Prior experience as a founder, CTO, or engineering leader who has chosen to return to individual contribution.
  • Real depth in one of our blueprint industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare, asset management.
  • Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery.
  • Data platform depth: data lakes, warehouses, streaming and real-time analytics, data mesh and data contracts, governance and data quality.
  • MLOps and classical ML: PyTorch, SageMaker, MLflow.
  • Fine-tuning, distillation, or inference/serving optimization.
  • Graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
  • IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform.
  • Open-source contributions or public writing on applied AI.

What you’ll do:

    Take the seat

    • Do the operator’s job for two to four weeks at the start of an engagement. Learn the function from inside, not from a requirements doc.
    • Reach working fluency in a new domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset flow — in weeks, not quarters.
    • Sit with the operator and the Forward Deployed Executive and redesign the function from first principles. Discovery, user research, and PRD-writing collapse into one team that re-imagines its own job. You are all three roles.

      • Build

      • Ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment — LLM applications, agentic workflows, retrieval and structured-extraction pipelines, and the services around them. Running software, not recommendations.
      • Build the evaluation harness before you build the feature. When the engagement is bound to a business KPI, “it looked good in testing” is not an answer. Define what working means, instrument it, and let the evals drive the design.
      • Write production code across the stack — backend services, data pipelines, and the AI layer. Python and TypeScript are our centre of gravity; we choose tools to fit the customer, not the résumé.
      • Take systems to production on AWS (GCP/Azure where the customer requires it): containerized, observable, and maintainable after we leave.
      • Start from the blueprint, and feed the blueprint. What you learn in the field becomes the baseline the next engagement starts from.

        • Own the outcome

        • Work in a pair with a Forward Deployed Executive who carries the Business Unit’s KPIs. Your work is measured against the same number.
        • Drive adoption. A system the BU routes around has not shipped. Change management is part of the engineering job here, not a phase after it.
        • Be credible with the customer’s engineers, their operators, and their executives — and be willing to disagree with all three.
        • Shape what we commit to before we commit to it. You’ll have the standing to do it, because you’re the one who will build it.

What We Offer:

  • Frontier delivery work across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare
  • The chance to shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment
  • A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside Principal Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers
  • A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them
  • Remote-friendly culture
  • High-impact role with direct visibility to leadership.
  • Strong earning potential with performance-based bonuses.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and cloud solutions.
  • B2B contract model.
  • PTO policy, paid local public holidays.
  • Medical insurance coverage
  • Generous budget for educational opportunities.

How we hire:

    1. Intro conversation — the role, your background, what you want to be doing.
    2. Two live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor. You may use an LLM assistant (ChatGPT, Claude) — how you work now includes these tools. Autocomplete/agentic coding tools are off for these sessions.
    3. The redesign session. We hand you an unfamiliar business function and the constraints of the person who performs it. You have to understand the job well enough to rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. No LLMs for this one.
    4. Team and practice conversation.

The Designer works with the Project Managers, Architects, Engineers, and CAD Technicians, and is responsible for producing high quality construction documentation in accordance with the project schedule and standards.

The Designer will work as a part of a national team delivering a variety of services in the residential and commercial markets. They must possess and exhibit a positive, “can do” attitude even in high stress situations with an unwavering commitment to “world class customer service.”

  • Comply with Fieldstone and client-specific standards (CAD, File Management, etc.).
  • Participate in occasional team meetings to help resolve project issues such as coordination, scheduling, and technical concerns.
  • Document time and expenses using Fieldstone’s business management system.

Architectural Practice Responsibilities

  • Adhere to ethical standards and codes of professional conduct.
  • Develop professional and leadership skills within firm.
  • Comply with laws and regulations governing the practice of architecture.
  • Participate in community activities that may provide opportunities or design of facilities that reflect community needs.
  • Understand implications of project delivery technologies.

jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a Criminal Enforcement Coordinator to join our Criminal Enforcement Unit Function within the Safety & Surveillance group.

This is a permanent full-time opportunity. The role is a home-based role but will require occasional travel to 10 South Colonnade, Canary Wharf London, E14 4PU or South Mimms, Hertfordshire. Please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas.

Who are we?

The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) enhance and improve the health of millions of people every day through the effective regulation of medicines and medical devices, underpinned by science and research.

The Criminal Enforcement Unit (CEU) is the dedicated law enforcement function of the MHRA. Its strategic aim is to reduce and eliminate offences involving medicines and medical devices, protecting public health and maintaining confidence in the UK's regulatory framework.

The Unit investigates serious and organised crime linked to the illegal manufacture, importation and supply of medicines and medical devices, using intelligence-led approaches to identify threats and target those who seek to profit from criminality. We work closely with law enforcement, government, regulatory and international partners to protect the public and safeguard the integrity of the UK's medicines and medical devices supply chains.

The Unit comprises a highly skilled multidisciplinary workforce with experience drawn from policing, Regional Organised Crime Units, the National Crime Agency, intelligence, regulatory enforcement and other specialist disciplines. The CEU consists of seven teams, each reporting to a Grade 7 Senior Manager. These teams are aligned to one of two Commands: Intelligence and Innovation, and Investigation and Disruption. Each is led by a Head of Command, who reports directly to the Deputy Director of Criminal Enforcement.

Working in the CEU offers the opportunity to contribute directly to protecting public health, tackling crime, and making a tangible impact on the safety of patients and the wider public.

What’s the role?

The Criminal Enforcement Coordinator role is a EO grade working within the Bureau and Online team. Their core responsibilities are to:

  • Support activities that prevent, disrupt and reduce medicines and medical devices-related offending.

  • Deliver work to a high professional standard and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

  • Work effectively with colleagues across the Criminal Enforcement Unit and wider Agency to achieve shared objectives.

  • Lead or contribute to projects and initiatives that improve operational effectiveness and organisational performance.

  • Adapt to changing priorities and support different areas of work as required.

Key responsibilities:

  • Maintain accurate records and information across MHRA systems, using digital tools to support operational activity.

  • Support the triage and processing of referrals from internal and external sources, ensuring information is accurately recorded and progressed in line with established procedures.

  • Provide effective administrative and business support, working with colleagues and stakeholders to support operational delivery and meet agreed timescales.

Who are we looking for?

Our successful candidate will:

  • Have strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, work independently and deliver accurate, high-quality work to agreed deadlines.

  • Have good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to record and communicate information clearly and accurately.
