jobs.description:
Analyste de données

Sommaire du rôle

En tant qu’analyste de données, vous appuierez la prise de décisions d’affaires en recueillant, organisant et interprétant des données afin d’identifier les tendances, les occasions et les secteurs nécessitant des améliorations. Vous collaborerez avec les parties prenantes de l’ensemble de l’organisation pour élaborer des rapports, des tableaux de bord et des solutions offrant une visibilité sur les principales activités et la performance de l’entreprise.

Vous contribuerez à des projets axés sur l’amélioration des processus, l’efficacité opérationnelle et l’efficacité organisationnelle, en aidant les équipes à exploiter les données et les technologies afin d’atteindre les objectifs d’affaires et de favoriser l’amélioration continue.

Responsabilités

  • Identifier et résoudre des problèmes complexes ou ambiguës, en transformant les données en informations claires et exploitables qui influencent directement les décisions des dirigeants.
  • Concevoir des pipelines de données, des rapports, des pratiques exemplaires et des cadres de travail permettant aux analystes et aux autres parties prenantes de l’organisation d’accéder efficacement aux informations nécessaires.
  • Transformer des formats de données complexes en indicateurs de performance fondés sur les données, en tableaux de bord intelligents et en applications intégrant l’intelligence artificielle.
  • Moderniser les processus manuels en les convertissant en systèmes évolutifs, automatisés et orientés vers les insights, en tirant parti de l’analyse statistique, des plateformes de données infonuagiques (cloud) et des technologies d’intelligence artificielle.

Le.la candidat.e idéal.e en quelques mots:

Qualifications requises

  • Baccalauréat en informatique, en science des données, en analytique des données, en statistique, en mathématiques, en génie, dans un domaine technique connexe ou expérience équivalente.
  • Expérience avancée dans l’utilisation de l’analytique pour résoudre des problèmes d’ingénierie, réaliser des analyses statistiques et programmer (p. ex. SQL, Python, R).
  • Expérience démontrée dans la création de tableaux de bord, de rapports et d’ensembles de données structurés pour soutenir les décisions d’affaires et d’ingénierie.
  • Excellentes compétences analytiques, en résolution de problèmes et en analyse statistique.
  • Maîtrise du français et une forte maîtrise de l’anglais est requise (la maîtrise du mandarin est un atout).

La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise pour ce poste afin d’assurer des communications efficaces avec les équipes à l’extérieur du Québec et de contribuer aux activités de notre entreprise internationale.

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Expérience avec les outils d’analytique et la gestion des données propres à Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Expérience dans la conception de pipelines de données (ETL) et la modélisation des données.
  • Expérience pratique avec les modèles d’intelligence artificielle et d’apprentissage automatique (IA/AA), les grands modèles de langage (LLM) et l’automatisation des flux de travail alimentée par l’IA.
  • Solide expérience dans la gestion des attentes des parties prenantes et la présentation de solutions.

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Apprenez et évoluez à travers plusieurs projets de pointe
  • Télétravail
  • Un jour de congé supplémentaire pour votre anniversaire
  • Une rémunération globale compétitive et des avantages sociaux concurrentiels
  • Congés mobiles payés entre Noël et le Jour de l’an
  • Rabais significatif sur l'abonnement de transport en commun de Montréal
  • Faites partie d’une entreprise qui place les critères ESG au cœur de sa mission pour les personnes, la planète et la performance.

Averna souscrit au principe de l’équité en matière d’emploi et est déterminé à encourager la diversité et l’inclusion. Nous sommes heureux d’étudier la demande d’emploi de tous les candidats qualifiés, sans égard à leur race, couleur, religion, orientation sexuelle, genre, nationalité d’origine, âge, handicap, statut d’ancien combattant ou tout autre statut protégé par la loi.

En janvier 2026, Averna et Spherea ont uni leurs forces pour former le Groupe Spherea. Leader mondial des solutions de test et de qualité, Averna Powered by Spherea collabore avec les concepteurs, développeurs et fabricants de produits afin de les aider à améliorer la qualité de leurs produits, accélérer leur mise sur le marché et protéger leurs marques, en couvrant l’ensemble du cycle de vie des produits grâce à des solutions et à une expertise complète.

Averna Powered by Spherea propose une expertise spécialisée ainsi que des solutions innovantes en matière de tests, d’inspection par vision, d’assemblage de précision et d’automatisation, offrant des avantages techniques, financiers et commerciaux significatifs aux clients des secteurs de l’aéronautique, de l’automobile, de l’électronique grand public, de la défense, de l’énergie, de l’industrie, des dispositifs médicaux et des sciences de la vie, des semi‑conducteurs, des télécommunications et du transport.

Ses solutions comprennent le prototypage et le conseil, l’assemblage de précision et la production, des solutions de test automatisées, des systèmes de test en ligne, la réplication de systèmes de test ainsi que des plateformes et produits de test. L’expertise d’Averna Powered by Spherea couvre notamment les systèmes de vision, les tests spécialisés de batteries, les radiofréquences et micro‑ondes, la fibre optique, la robotique et le mouvement, l’instrumentation, les systèmes de contrôle et la gestion des données.

Job Description

Job Title: Sr. Sales Manager - Mining

Working Pattern: Full Time

Working location: Novi, MI or Working from Home US

Relocation assistance is available for this position.

Why Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you’ll have the opportunity to create world-class power and propulsion solutions, pushing your problem-solving and ingenuity, to deliver real impact that puts safety first.

You’ll be given responsibility and the opportunity to grow in our high-performance culture. This is Infinite Potential. And it’s your chance to really shine and contribute to one of the world’s most recognized brands and a beacon for engineering excellence.

Position Summary

The Sr. Sales Manager, Mining is the primary commercial driver for mtu power systems in the North American Mining market, responsible for managing sales opportunities from concept to contract across a defined territory and distribution partner network. This role owns the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new business opportunities and securing service contracts, to building C-suite customer relationships and serving as the strategic point of contact for distribution partners. With direct influence over revenue growth, market share, and long-term customer partnerships in one of Power Systems' key industrial segments, this is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for an experienced commercial leader.

What you will be doing

  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities — work with distribution partners across North America to generate and advance sales opportunities for mtu power systems, securing contracts that drive profitable revenue growth in the Mining segment.
  • Build and own senior customer relationships — engage key customers at the highest management levels, negotiate and secure sales and service contracts (including VCA and EC agreements), and collaborate with the Service and Service Sales teams to deliver a total sales and service solution.
  • Manage accounts from a full commercial perspective — serve as the primary point of contact for distribution partners, address customer concerns promptly, provide guidance on policy decisions, and act as project manager when required to ensure smooth execution from concept through delivery.
  • Monitor the market and drive accurate forecasting — track industry trends, competitor activity, business conditions, and account status, reporting insights to leadership to support strategic planning and pipeline accuracy.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (up to 50%).

Basic Requirements:

  • Associate's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field with 7+ years of experience in technical sales or service management of industrial equipment, OR
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field with 5+ years of experience in technical sales or service management of industrial equipment, OR
  • Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field with 3+ years of experience in technical sales or service management of industrial equipment, OR
  • JD/PhD in Engineering, Business, or a related field, OR
  • 9+ years of experience in technical sales or service management of complex industrial power systems in lieu of a degree
  • In order to be eligible for consideration, you must be a U.S. Citizen or U.S. Permanent. Resident Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S without sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time

Preferred Requirements:

  • Strong technical knowledge and proven success in value selling complex power systems, including diesel engines, to industrial customers.
  • Strong familiarity with mining equipment, operations, and the North American Mining market.
  • Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce, SAP CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar) and MS Office Suite, with a track record of maintaining accurate pipeline data, account records, and sales forecasting in a structured commercial environment.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales opportunities from concept through contract (including project management involvement) in a distribution partner or channel sales model within the Mining, Oil & Gas, or heavy industrial sector.
  • Knowledge of mtu and/or Rolls-Royce Power Systems products, service contracts (VCA, EC), policies, and distribution network or equivalent deep familiarity with a comparable diesel engine or industrial power systems brand.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote or field-based environment, make sound commercial decisions with minimal supervision, and communicate complex technical and commercial proposals clearly to senior customer and partner stakeholders.

Power Systems is the Rolls-Royce business which provides world-class power solutions and complete life-cycle support under our product and solution brand mtu. Through digitalisation and electrification, we strive to develop drive and power generation solutions that provide answers to the challenges posed by the rapidly growing societal demands for energy and mobility.

We deliver and service comprehensive, powerful and reliable systems, based on both gas and diesel engines, as well as electrified hybrid systems. These technologically advanced solutions serve our customers in the marine and infrastructure sectors worldwide.

Our vision is to ensure that the quality and dynamism that shaped our history continues into our future. It’s a bold pursuit, and we never stop striving to go further, faster, and better. We lead progress, creating the technologies that move us forward. If you’re driven to grow, to learn, and to make a lasting difference, this is where you belong.

Rolls-Royce is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristics. We are committed to providing a respectful and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued and everyone can thrive.

Eligible employees may have the opportunity to enroll in other benefits, including health, dental, vision, disability, life and accidental death & dismemberment insurance; a flexible spending account; a health savings account; a 401(k) retirement savings plan with a company match; Employee Assistance Program; Paid Time Off; certain paid holidays; paid parental and family care leave; tuition reimbursement; and a long-term incentive plan. Company Overview: Bold AI is an AI transformation company. We help enterprises use AI to change how they work, get found inside AI answers, and create content at scale. We build the platforms that make it real.

Role Overview: As a 3D Render Artist on Bold AI's Flywheel team, you build and render 3D work with AI as a native part of your pipeline and finish in Blender. You move fast across the Creative and Production phases, taking a brief from concept to on-brand, photoreal or stylized execution at a volume that would be impossible by hand. You produce for named enterprise accounts, hold the line on brand, and feed every learning back into the system so each cycle starts sharper than the last.

About the Flywheel Platform: Flywheel is our proprietary platform that runs the content supply chain end to end. Our production team operates it, and you create inside it every day. It ingests a brand from a URL or brand book into a structured, prompt-ready profile (palette, tone, audience, visual direction), then lets you brief and generate across multiple models from one workspace, including image, motion, and text-to-3D. You organize, compare, and approve output in Collections, run an automated brand-fit and brand-safety check with Persona Lens, repair AI artifacts with Pixel Fix, and upscale to final delivery resolution. A production calendar keeps every asset and deadline on track, and one-click export ships shareable review links.

The stack you'll work in: Flywheel, Superscale, Luma, Open Art AI, Higgsfield, Canva, Claude, ChatGPT, Adobe Creative Cloud, Linear, and Topaz.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with the team in our time zone, which is EST Toronto, Canada

  • Model, texture, light, and render 3D assets for product, social, campaign, and motion

  • Use AI 3D and image tools to generate base meshes, concepts, textures, and references at high throughput inside Flywheel

  • Take generated and rendered output the last mile in Blender and Adobe: shading, lighting, compositing, and finishing to brand standard

  • Build and maintain asset libraries, material and shader presets, render templates, and prompt references that raise first-pass yield

  • Hold the line on brand across hundreds of executions for accounts like Nature Fresh Farms and Samsung

  • Keep work on-brand and platform-native, never generic AI output

  • Partner with the Creative Director and brand and production leads inside production pods

  • Feed learnings back into Flywheel so each cycle starts sharper and the system gets smarter

What You Bring

  • A strong portfolio of 3D render and motion work across product, brand, and campaign

  • Deep Blender skills: modeling, shading, lighting, and rendering (Cycles and EEVEE)

  • Daily, hands-on command of AI 3D and image tools across text-to-3D, image, video, and upscaling; you adopt new models fast (our stack includes Luma, Higgsfield, Open Art AI, Superscale, and Topaz)

  • Strong texturing and look-dev sense (Substance a plus)

  • A finishing eye that tells a good generation or raw render from a finished frame and closes the gap

  • Comfort with high throughput; you produce volume without dropping quality

  • Brand discipline to carry a client's visual identity across large execution counts

  • 4+ years of 3D and render experience in agency, studio, or in-house settings

Nice to Have

  • Motion and animation (keyframe, simulation, or procedural)

  • Real-time pipelines (Unreal Engine, Spline) or alternate DCCs (Cinema 4D, Houdini, ZBrush)

  • GPU rendering experience (Octane, Redshift, KeyShot)

  • Compositing in After Effects or Nuke

  • Experience building or maintaining 3D asset and material libraries

Role Details

  • Team: Flywheel

  • Focus: On-brand, platform-native 3D and render work at high throughput across digital initiatives

  • Collaborative, cross-functional environment with international stakeholders

Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

The Business Intelligence & Analytics function within Datavant Product is actively seeking a Data Governance Analyst to strengthen our Enterprise Data Governance and Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities. This pillar focuses on building a scalable and trusted data foundation that establishes clear ownership, consistent definitions, and a governed single source of truth across provider, payer, life sciences, legal & insurance, and finance domains.

In this role, you will help operationalize Datavant’s governance and MDM practices by partnering cross-functionally to improve how master data, metadata, and stewardship workflows are managed across systems. If you thrive at the intersection of business strategy, data architecture, and compliance, and enjoy driving alignment across technical and non-technical teams, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

As a Staff Product Manager for the GenAI Safety team within Trust & Safety, you'll define and drive the product strategy for ensuring Pinterest's GenAI-powered systems are safe, fair, and trustworthy. You'll be responsible for building proactive safety frameworks that scale with our growing AI capabilities, partnering deeply with engineering, policy, data science, and design to protect our users while enabling Pinterest to innovate responsibly.

This is a high-impact role for someone who is passionate about the intersection of AI and user safety, and who thrives in ambiguous, fast-evolving problem spaces. You'll work at the frontier of responsible AI - anticipating novel harms before they emerge, red-teaming new AI features, and translating complex policy goals into measurable product requirements.

What you'll do:

  • GenAI Safety Strategy: Own and drive the product roadmap for GenAI safety across Pinterest's AI-powered surfaces, including assisted search, content recommendations, automated moderation, and generative content creation tools
  • Threat Modeling & Red-Teaming: Lead proactive identification of risks, failure modes, and adversarial attack vectors across AI systems - designing structured red-teaming exercises and evaluation frameworks before and after product launches
  • Policy-to-Product Translation: Partner closely with Trust & Safety policy, legal, and ethics teams to translate nuanced content guidelines (e.g., self-harm, misinformation, body image) into precise, buildable product requirements and model guardrails
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with engineering, ML, design, data science, policy, legal, comms, and operations teams to define, align, and ship AI safety solutions across global markets and diverse user populations
  • Evaluation & Measurement: Define and track quantitative safety metrics - including fairness audits, false positive/negative rates, disparate impact analysis, and content harm reduction - to ensure AI systems meet safety standards at scale
  • Incident Response: Develop and maintain AI safety incident runbooks and escalation frameworks, and lead rapid triage and remediation when AI systems produce harmful or unexpected outputs
  • Emerging Risk Anticipation: Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI landscape to identify safety implications of new capabilities (e.g., multi-modal generation, synthetic media, agentic AI) and proactively build extensible safety infrastructure to address unknown future applications
  • Global & Cultural Sensitivity: Ensure AI safety approaches account for the needs, norms, and contexts of Pinterest's diverse global user base - avoiding one-size-fits-all solutions and centering equity in safety design
  • User & Employee Wellbeing: Champion the safety and psychological wellbeing of both users who encounter harmful content and internal teams (content reviewers, T&S specialists) who work on the front lines of content safety

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful depth in GenAI/ML, trust & safety, content moderation, or responsible AI
  • Strong fluency in AI/ML concepts - including generative models, recommendation systems, multi-modal AI, and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF)
  • Experience with AI ethics frameworks, responsible AI principles, or relevant regulatory landscapes (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams through ambiguous, high-stakes problem spaces with a bias for action
  • Proficiency in engaging with research, mapping threat models, validating risks, and translating insights into clear product strategies and roadmaps
  • Excellent communication skills - the ability to articulate complex technical and ethical trade-offs to non-technical audiences and senior leadership, facilitating clear decision-making
  • Deep empathy for users and a genuine commitment to making the internet safer
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience

Relocation Statement:

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

  • We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

We are building the client's AWS enterprise cloud foundation from the ground up, and we are building it with an Agentic Software Development Life Cycle (Agentic-SDLC). This is the senior technical seat on the account. You will own the architecture across workstreams — the multi-account AWS landing zone (Network, Shared Services, and Workload Non-Prod and Prod), the application architecture running on top of it, and the platform architecture that comes next. You will also lead the operational team as tech lead: setting the technical direction, unblocking engineers, and shipping code yourself. This is a hands-on role. The person who owns the diagram is the person who writes the CDK.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture Ownership: Own the AWS enterprise architecture end to end — multi-account governance and guardrails, Transit Gateway topology, hybrid connectivity to on-premises data centers, centralized traffic inspection, hybrid DNS, and the security posture that holds it all together. You write the ADRs, you defend them to the client, and you revisit them when they stop being true.
  • Tech Leadership with Your Hands On: Lead the operational team day to day — technical direction, design review, code review, and the architectural decisions that unblock delivery. You are also expected to build: CDK stacks, Lambda functions, agent tooling.
  • Agent Development & Orchestration: Design and extend the agents that carry our delivery — intent decomposition, design artifact generation, implementation scaffolding, validation, and gate reporting. Author the capability instructions they run on so agents produce architecture-compliant work without a human restating the standards each time. About the Role

At Pavago, we are hiring for one of our clients seeking a detail-oriented Transaction Coordinator to manage the administrative and compliance side of real estate transactions in California.

You will support agents from the time a purchase agreement is signed through the close of escrow. Your role will be to keep transaction files organized, track important deadlines, make sure required documents are completed, and coordinate with agents, escrow/title officers, lenders, clients, and other parties involved in the transaction.

This is an operations-focused role that requires strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple transactions at the same time.

Responsibilities

Transaction & File Management

  • Open and manage transaction files in the transaction management platform from executed purchase agreement through close of escrow.
  • Review contracts, addenda, and disclosures to make sure files are complete and properly documented.
  • Maintain organized and accurate transaction files according to brokerage recordkeeping and compliance requirements.
  • Prepare and organize documents for review, approval, and signature.

Deadlines & Compliance

  • Track important transaction deadlines, including contingency periods, inspection windows, loan and appraisal contingencies, and close-of-escrow dates.
  • Proactively monitor deadlines and alert agents when action is required.
  • Collect and confirm required California disclosure forms and transaction documents.
  • Help ensure transaction files meet California and brokerage compliance requirements.
  • Identify missing or incomplete documents before they create delays or compliance issues.

Communication & Coordination

  • Act as a point of contact between agents, escrow/title officers, lenders, clients, and other transaction parties.
  • Keep all relevant parties informed about transaction progress and outstanding requirements.
  • Follow up on pending documents, signatures, approvals, and other transaction items.
  • Help keep transactions moving smoothly from contract to closing.

Documents & Transaction Support

  • Prepare and route documents for electronic signatures using platforms such as DocuSign or similar tools.
  • Coordinate additional transaction items such as home warranty orders, repair documentation, and vendor scheduling.
  • Support agents with administrative tasks related to active transactions.
  • Manage multiple files and transactions while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple deadlines at the same time.
  • You pay close attention to details and can quickly identify missing or incorrect information.
  • You are proactive and follow up on tasks without needing constant supervision.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally with agents, clients, and external partners.
  • You are comfortable working with contracts, disclosures, transaction documents, and real estate systems.
  • You can stay organized and calm while managing multiple transactions at different stages.
  • You take ownership of your work and understand the importance of accuracy in real estate transactions.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Haves

  • 1–3+ years of experience as a Transaction Coordinator, Escrow Assistant, or in a similar real estate transaction support role.
  • Working knowledge of California residential real estate transactions, contracts, timelines, and disclosure requirements.
  • Strong understanding of transaction coordination from executed contract through close of escrow.
  • Experience managing multiple transactions, files, or deadlines at the same time.
  • Experience using transaction management and electronic signature platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to proactively track deadlines and follow up on outstanding items.
  • Ability to work independently and manage tasks without constant supervision.
  • California Real Estate License is not required for this role.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience supporting multiple real estate agents or a full brokerage team.
  • Experience with DocuSign Rooms, Dotloop, or similar transaction management platforms.
  • Experience working with California disclosure forms such as TDS, NHD, SPQ, and AVID.
  • Previous experience coordinating with escrow/title companies, lenders, and other transaction partners.
  • Bilingual Spanish/English communication skills.
  • Experience working in a real estate brokerage or transaction coordination environment.

Interview Process

  • Initial screening with Pavago.
  • Client interview.
  • Final selection and onboarding.

Proper AI is an AI-first accounting service built for property managers and real estate operators.

By combining automation, technology, and a global team of accounting experts, we deliver faster, more accurate financial operations at scale.

We’re a team of builders, problem-solvers, and operators from around the world, working together to modernize one of the most critical functions in real estate.

Learn more at

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong backend and systems fundamentals to help own the core of our platform: the services, data models, and automations behind workflow and productivity tooling for B2B accounting operations.

This is a depth role, not a breadth role. The work is logic-heavy — multi-service data flows, third-party platform integrations, and document-processing pipelines where correctness matters more than surface area. The engineer will be a technical counterpart to the Tech Lead on architecture, and will take ownership of our AI-backed document processing service.

The ideal candidate is language-agnostic in outlook but deep in practice: comfortable moving between Go, Python, and TypeScript, and able to build a real working model of an unfamiliar system before changing it.

Key Responsibilities

    Core Functional Responsibilities

    • Design, build, and maintain backend services across a microservices estate (Go, NestJS/TypeScript, Python).

    • Own the AI-backed document processing and classification service (Python/FastAPI): extraction quality, accuracy measurement, and the pipeline around it.

    • Design and maintain integrations with third-party platforms, including authentication, sync cadence, retries, and recovery.

    • Model data deliberately — schemas, migrations, and invariants that hold as the product changes.

    • Debug across service boundaries: correlate behaviour across multiple systems and databases to find the actual cause.

    • Build observability and provenance into automated flows: actions should be traceable, auditable, and reconstructable after the fact.

    • Design for safe automation: idempotency, pre/postconditions, dry-runs, and guardrails on anything that writes to a customer's system of record.

    • Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and leave the systems better instrumented than found.

      • Performance and Metrics Tracking

      • Define and track correctness and reliability measures for owned systems (task success, error and fallback rates, accuracy of automated inference).

      • Build evaluation coverage for AI-backed output: scenario tests, invariant checks, and regression detection when a model or prompt changes.

      • Monitor and improve latency, retries, and failure recovery in automated pipelines.

        • Training and Development

        • Mentor mid-level engineers on system design, debugging methodology, and testing discipline.

        • Lead design discussions and code reviews.

        • Document architecture decisions, failure modes, and debugging runbooks.

Required Hard Skills

  • Backend engineering depth — production services in Go and/or Python; TypeScript/Node useful. Multi-language comfort matters more than any single stack.
  • Data modelling and relational databases — PostgreSQL, schema design, migrations, query performance, and reasoning about data integrity.
  • Distributed and cross-service debugging — tracing behaviour across services, queues, and databases to isolate a root cause.
  • Third-party integration engineering — external APIs with imperfect contracts: auth expiry, partial failures, retries, idempotency.
  • Reliability practice — observability, structured logging, tracing, failure-mode analysis, and recovery design.
  • Testing and evaluation — unit and scenario tests, invariant checks, and measuring correctness of non-deterministic (AI-backed) output.
  • Cloud and infrastructure — GCP preferred (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub); Docker and CI/CD.
  • Working with LLM-backed services — using them as components, understanding their failure modes, and validating their output. Prior agent-framework experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Required Soft Skills

  • Calibrates depth to stakes. Ships routine, low-risk work quickly; deliberately slows down on core systems, data models, and anything touching money or client data — and can tell the difference without being told.

  • Verifies before concluding. Checks the premise of a bug report rather than building on it; can distinguish a real defect from correct behaviour measured the wrong way. Reads the system before changing it. Builds a working model of how something actually behaves, then changes it.

  • Owns outcomes, not tickets. Goes past the literal ticket text when the ticket is wrong, incomplete, or describes the wrong problem.

  • Strong communicator of design decisions, trade-offs, and risk, to technical and non technical audiences.

  • Pragmatic and collaborative — high standards without perfectionism, and works well with Product and Operations.

Nice-to-Have Skills / Experiences

  • Experience in both high-growth startups and larger engineering organisations. Accounting, fintech, or other domain where correctness is non-negotiable. Document processing, OCR, or information-extraction pipelines.

  • Vector databases / retrieval (e.g. Qdrant) and prompt or model evaluation. Frontend familiarity (Vue or React) — useful for full-feature ownership, not a core requirement.

  • B2B SaaS background.

Type of Degree

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. Strong CS fundamentals matter; the credential does not.

Years of Experience in Field

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering, with a majority in backend or systems work. Demonstrated ownership of a non-trivial production system (not just feature delivery within someone else's design).

  • Experience at an organisation with mature engineering standards is valuable.

jobs.excerpt: Why Thunderbird? Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally.
jobs.description:
Why Thunderbird?

Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At MZLA, the team behind Thunderbird, we build privacy-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data.

We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first.

We are a small but growing company of 60+ people distributed across seven countries. As Thunderbird evolves beyond a single desktop application, we are expanding across desktop, mobile, paid services, and new product experiences that help people and organizations work more effectively without giving up control to big tech ecosystems.

Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s apps freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long-term sustainability and continued innovation.

A note about MZLA and Mozilla: MZLA Technologies Corporation is the nonprofit-owned company behind Thunderbird and part of the Mozilla family. MZLA is separate from Mozilla Corporation and has its own compensation programs, benefits, and employment policies.

To learn more, visit and

The opportunity

MZLA is entering a new phase of growth as we bring Thunderbird, Thunderbolt, and other current and future products and services into the enterprise market. Our enterprise approach will be partner-led, with external partners leading sales, implementation, and ongoing customer relationships while MZLA provides the products, technical expertise, and subject-matter knowledge needed for success.

Our move into the enterprise market is being shaped in part by growing interest in digital sovereignty, particularly in Europe, where enterprises and public-sector organizations are placing greater emphasis on control over data and infrastructure, deployment flexibility, privacy, security, interoperability, and reduced vendor dependence.

We are looking for a Senior Lead, Enterprise Partnerships & Strategy to add dedicated partnership and commercial expertise to work already underway. You will partner closely with the CEO, senior leadership, and cross-functional teams to shape MZLA’s enterprise strategy, evaluate opportunities, develop partnership and commercial models, shape pricing and packaging, and advance a cohesive enterprise offering across our products and services.

This is a hands-on role in a lean environment. Success will require someone who can operate credibly with senior leaders and external partners while remaining closely involved in the analysis, preparation, coordination, negotiation, and follow-through needed to move opportunities forward and build a more repeatable enterprise approach.

This role requires regular working-hour overlap with colleagues in North American time zones, as well as flexibility to meet with partners and stakeholders across Europe. This role will also include periodic travel, including international, to meet with partners, prospective customers and represent MZLA at relevant industry events.

What you’ll do

  • Help define and execute an enterprise strategy across MZLA’s products and services.
  • Translate digital sovereignty priorities into clear enterprise and partnership requirements.
  • Identify, evaluate, and advance enterprise opportunities and strategic partnerships, particularly in Europe and other sovereignty-focused markets.
  • Work with stakeholders to clarify roles across MZLA, external partners, and other Mozilla entities.
  • Develop pricing, packaging, licensing, reseller, revenue-sharing, support, implementation, and other commercial models.
  • Lead or support partner negotiations and senior-level commercial discussions.
  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to understand capabilities, deployment options, integrations, security and privacy considerations, support requirements, and roadmap dependencies.
  • Translate technical capabilities into clear enterprise propositions and partner plans.
  • Build practical processes and decision frameworks that support repeatable execution and help ensure external commitments remain realistic and supportable.

What you bring

  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience in product or strategic partnerships, enterprise strategy, commercial strategy, or technical business development.
  • Experience building a new partnership, enterprise, platform, or commercial capability in a partner-led environment.
  • Experience working with European enterprises, public-sector organizations, regulated institutions, technology partners, or similarly complex stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of digital sovereignty and the commercial, technical, regulatory, legal, and procurement considerations shaping technology decisions in Europe.
  • Experience working through resellers, systems integrators, implementation partners, or similar partner-led enterprise models.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and negotiating pricing, packaging, licensing, reseller, revenue-sharing, implementation, support, or similar commercial models, with strong judgment around enterprise buying processes, deal economics, negotiation strategy, and complex procurement.
  • Experience with technically complex software products, platforms, infrastructure, AI-enabled systems, communications technology, security, or privacy technology, with the technical and product fluency to work credibly with engineering, product, partner, and enterprise stakeholders.
  • Strong executive communication, relationship-management, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to bring structure to ambiguous opportunities and move comfortably between strategy and detailed execution.
  • A collaborative, low-ego working style and the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Strong alignment with Mozilla’s mission and values, including openness, privacy, user agency, trust, and long-term sustainability.
  • Ability and willingness to travel periodically, including internationally.

Bonus points for

  • Experience with on-premises, self-hosted, private-cloud, in-region, or other customer-controlled deployment models.
  • Experience with open-source software, open standards, or open technology ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled software, enterprise search, knowledge systems, communications platforms, productivity tools, or privacy-oriented technology.
  • Experience building partnerships or enterprise initiatives in an early-stage company, new business unit, or newly established function.
  • Experience coordinating partnerships across affiliated organizations or a portfolio of related products.

About you

You are a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable working in the details. You know that successful partnerships depend on more than strong relationships: they require sound product judgment, clear commercial models, technical credibility, and disciplined execution.

You understand that enterprise technology decisions are shaped not only by features and price, but also by control, jurisdiction, trust, interoperability, and long-term technology dependence. You can translate those considerations into practical enterprise and partnership strategies without overstating what a product or organization can deliver.

You are comfortable representing an organization in senior external conversations while remaining hands-on with pricing, preparation, technical dependencies, coordination, and follow-through. You are motivated by building a durable enterprise capability in a lean environment rather than inheriting a mature program or immediately building a large team.

Work environment

This is a full-time, fully remote position. You’ll work with colleagues, partners, and customers across multiple countries and time zones, so strong communication and documentation skills are essential.

Compensation & benefits

We benchmark our base salaries to local markets and target the 60th percentile of the peer market. The salary ranges for this role are:

  • Canada: $140,000-$180,000 CAD

This is a salaried, non-commissioned role and is eligible for MZLA’s annual discretionary bonus program.

The salary range shown reflects the intended level and scope of the position. We may consider candidates with strong relevant skills but less experience, in which case title, level, and compensation may be adjusted accordingly.

In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your whole self.

Work & career

  • Fully remote work & schedule flexibility
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Annual bonus program
  • Monthly remote work stipend
  • Annual professional development stipend
  • Access toCoursera learning platform
  • Industry conferences

Rest & play

  • Your birthday
  • Year-end company shutdown
  • 9 wellbeing days

  • Other paid leave
  • Quarterly wellbeing stipend for personal / family activities

Health & family

  • RRSP contributions

  • Disability insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid sick days

Work eligibility

Applicants must reside in and have permanent work authorization for the country location(s) specified in the posting. We are unable to consider applicants outside of these markets at this time. And, we do not provide visa sponsorship.

How to apply

Please apply directly through our career page. This role serves as the regional concierge for customers and sales teams, driving customers through the decision funnel and ensuring a smooth, informed path to “yes.” This role combines customer advocacy, market intelligence, and commercial execution.

This is a hands-on execution role, focused on working with Architects & Designers (A&D), contractors, subcontractors, and distributors. The role partners closely with regional sales to identify opportunities, monitor active opportunities, remove barriers, and help convert interest into orders.

Customer & Project Execution

  • Serve as the regional customer concierge — identify what customers need to move forward and coordinate internal resources to deliver it.

  • Monitor key regional projects and opportunity progress to ensure timely follow-up and engagement.

Customer Insight & Feedback

Coordination & Cross-Functional Support

  • Coordinate with technical, product, incentives, and operations teams to ensure customers receive timely and accurate information.
  • Support regional training, events, or customer engagement activities as needed.
  • Help improve execution processes that enhance the overall customer experience.

  • Working knowledge and experience in construction, contracting, distribution, specification sales, commercial building products, and knowledge of market segments, customers, and distribution channels.
  • Experience working in or supporting the design and construction ecosystem (A&D, contractor, distributor, or building products environment) preferred.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) or similar CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Excellent communication and follow-through.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with field sales and cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for an Incentive Compensation Systems Manager to join our Incentive Compensation (IC) team and drive the systemization, automation, and continuous improvement of our commission operations. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership, reporting to the Senior Manager, Incentive Compensation. To be successful, you should look forward to operating in an unstructured, fast-paced, remote-first environment where you will identify gaps in existing processes, replace manual workarounds with scalable systems, and bring greater predictability, accuracy, and speed to how the business manages commissions, quotas, and comp plan administration.

In this role, you will gain deep exposure to how incentive compensation data flows end-to-end from our CRM (e.g., SFDC), People systems (e.g., Workday) through calculation engines (e.g., Xactly) to payout and reporting (e.g., BigQuery). You'll be the person the team turns to when a process is slow, fragile, or held together by spreadsheets. You will partner closely with our Incentive Compensation Operations Team, Finance & Strategy, People Ops, and RevOps orgs to understand how work actually gets done today, find the friction points, and build the tooling and workflows that remove them. This role requires a unique balance: enough technical depth to design and build real automation, combined with the process discipline and cross-functional judgment to know which problems are worth solving first.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Process & Gap Assessment: Embed with the IC team to map current-state workflows across plan administration, calculation, approvals, and payout. Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone steps and prioritize them based on risk, time cost, and business impact.
  • Systematization & Automation: Design and build automated workflows, integrations, and tooling that replace manual processes from data pulls and reconciliations to approval routing and exception handling. Reduce reliance on ad-hoc spreadsheets and one-off scripts in favor of durable, repeatable systems.
  • Xactly ICM Ownership: Serve as a hands-on owner of our Xactly instances (e.g., Incent and Connect) configuring calculation rules, plan logic, and workflows, and continuously tuning the platform so it does more of the heavy lifting currently done manually outside the system.
  • AI-Enabled Process Automation: Identify where AI tools and LLM-driven agents can take over manual, repetitive Incentive Compensation work such as exception detection, data reconciliation, plan document review, or answering common comp questions and build the workflows/integrations to put them into production.
  • Systems Integration: Partner with IC, Finance & Strategy, People Ops, Revenue Operations, and IT/Data teams to ensure incentive compensation systems are properly integrated, with clean, reliable data flowing between them.
  • Documentation & Governance: Establish clear documentation, standard operating procedures, and controls for newly systematized processes, so they're auditable, maintainable, and don't regress back into manual work over time.
  • Continuous Improvement Cadence: Set up a repeatable process for the IC team to keep identifying and retiring manual work, as an ongoing discipline of finding the next bottleneck and fixing it.
  • Cross-Functional Enablement: Act as the go-to resource translating IC process needs into system requirements, and translating system/data constraints back into practical process recommendations the team can act on.
  • Operational Excellence: Support urgent, ad-hoc requests during payout cycles while keeping an eye on the long-term goal. Building yourself out of the fire-fighting role by systemizing the fixes.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience in incentive compensation, sales operations, revenue operations, or a related systems/process improvement role. Experience in a fast-paced technology or SaaS business is highly preferred.
  • Process Improvement Mindset: A demonstrated track record of finding manual, broken, or inefficient processes and systematizing them, not just documenting problems but building the solution.
  • SQL & Data Fluency: Hands-on SQL experience and comfort querying and reconciling data across systems to diagnose process gaps and validate automated outputs.
  • Automation & Tooling: Hands-on experience building automated workflows using tools such as scripting, workflow/RPA platforms, or ICM systems (e.g., Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Varicent, SPIFF platforms). Comfort standing up lightweight tools or integrations when off-the-shelf options fall short.
  • Systems Fluency: Familiarity with the core systems that touch incentive compensation: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), HRIS, data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery), and comp management platforms (e.g., Xactly) understanding how data moves between them.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Strong communication skills, with the ability to sit with a team, understand how they actually work day-to-day, and translate that into clear systems requirements and process changes.
  • Analytical Rigor: Understanding of core comp mechanics (quotas, accelerators, SPIFFs, payout timing) sufficient to spot where a process breaks down or introduces risk.

Bonus Points For:

  • Industry & Scale Context: Experience working in a high-growth SaaS, cloud, or open-source company, particularly within a public company or an environment undergoing IPO readiness.
  • Global Collaboration: Proven success working within globally distributed, remote-first organizations across multiple time zones.
  • AI & LLM-Driven Automation: Experience documenting datasets and workflows for Model Context Protocol (MCP) server ingestion, or building AI skills/agents to automate incentive compensation data discovery, exception detection, or reporting.

jobs.excerpt: Sobre a ZippiEstamos na missão de impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades.
jobs.description:
Sobre a Zippi

Estamos na missão de impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades.

Desde o nosso lançamento, há quatro anos, alcançamos a lucratividade e vivemos um período de crescimento exponencial. Até hoje, já concedemos mais de R$ 10 bilhões em crédito para micro e pequenos negócios em todo o Brasil. Estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de capital de giro no mercado brasileiro de MPBs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 3,5 trilhões por ano.

Nosso sucesso é impulsionado por uma abordagem altamente automatizada e baseada em dados. Com o apoio de investidores de alto nível, como Y Combinator e Tiger Global, formamos um time de tecnologia de calibre global focado em construir um futuro em que todo pequeno negócio no Brasil possa prosperar.

Sobre o Time

O Jurídico da Zippi está em um momento especialmente interessante de construção. Somos um time enxuto, responsável por apoiar o crescimento de uma fintech que opera em um ambiente jurídico complexo e regulado.

Com a expansão da Zippi, o volume e a diversidade das demandas jurídicas também cresceram — e estamos estruturando o time para acompanhar esse próximo capítulo. Isso significa que quem entrar agora encontrará uma área ainda em formação, com proximidade das decisões, exposição a diferentes frentes jurídicas e espaço real para ajudar a construir processos, nossa operação e formas de trabalhar desde cedo.

Sua Missão

Sua missão será se tornar uma peça-chave na construção da operação jurídica da Zippi, começando por três frentes centrais — contencioso, contratos e suporte consultivo às áreas internas — e ganhando autonomia progressiva sobre elas.

No dia a dia, você vai acompanhar uma carteira de processos cíveis e consumeristas em parceria com nosso escritório externo — incluindo o acompanhamento de casos junto a órgãos como PROCON e —, conduzir contratos comerciais de menor complexidade do início ao fim e apoiar times como Produto, Operações e People na resolução de dúvidas jurídicas recorrentes.

Mais do que executar essas rotinas, esperamos que você ajude a torná-las cada vez mais organizadas, eficientes e escaláveis: estruturando controles, acompanhando métricas, identificando lacunas e propondo melhorias nos processos em operação — inclusive com uso de IA e automações para reduzir trabalho manual e ganhar escala.

À medida que ganha domínio e autonomia nessas frentes, existe espaço para ampliar sua atuação para temas como trabalhista, compliance, privacidade e projetos de automação, construindo uma visão generalista do Jurídico de uma fintech em crescimento e assumindo progressivamente novas responsabilidades dentro do time.

O que buscamos:

  • OAB ativa (ou fase final de obtenção, ex.: aprovado(a) no exame aguardando emissão do número).
  • Base em contencioso cível: experiência elaborando subsídios/peças, acompanhando prazos processuais e organizando documentação, idealmente com responsabilidade sobre uma carteira, ainda que pequena.
  • Experiência emrevisão de contratos: prestação de serviços, NDAs, aditivos ou fornecedores.
  • Autonomia operacional: resolve e sinaliza proativamente quando trava, sem depender de instrução passo a passo — inclusive para identificar e apontar gaps ou inconsistências por conta própria.
  • Boa capacidade de execução: entende e se interessa por um escopo majoritariamente prático.
  • Curiosidade e iniciativa para usar IA e automações na melhoria de fluxos e rotinas jurídicas, buscando reduzir trabalho manual e tornar os processos mais eficientes e escaláveis.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas jurídicas (Elaw, DocuSign/ZapSign, Notion) ou facilidade para se adaptar a elas

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Exposição a trabalhista/People (contratos CLT/PJ, rescisões, políticas internas);
  • Familiaridade com temas de compliance, KYC/AML ou LGPD.
  • Contexto prévio em empresa regulada (fintech, crédito, meios de pagamento);
  • Experiência em consultivo interno a áreas de negócio (Produto, Operações, Comercial, People);
  • Regulatório Bacen/CVM/FIDC

Por que vir para a Zippi?

  • Uma causa pela qual vale a pena lutar: nossa missão é ajudar micro e pequenas empresas a prosperar. Seu trabalho impactará diretamente 22 milhões de empreendedores brasileiros, ampliando o acesso financeiro em um mercado enorme e carente de soluções.
  • Ownership e construção desde o primeiro dia: como early team member, você terá papel essencial na evolução e construção do Jurídico de uma startup lucrativa, bem financiada e apoiada por investidores de renome como Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Globo Ventures e Volpe Capital.
  • Aprendizado acelerado com gente boa: aqui você terá a oportunidade de se envolver em projetos estratégicos e enfrentar desafios complexos ao lado de fundadores e operadores de fintechs de ponta.

O que você pode esperar da gente!

  • Remuneração na faixa alta de mercado;
  • Learning Budget anual;
  • Plano de Saúde 100% pago pela Zippi para você e para dependentes até 18 anos. Para cônjuges e companheiros(as), cobrimos 50% da mensalidade;
  • Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos;
  • Vale-refeição no Caju;
  • Férias flexíveis;
  • Wellhub e Zenklub;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto.

jobs.description:
DataDome is looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our US team.

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will partner with Account Executives and prospective customers to define technical strategy, uncover business and security challenges, and demonstrate how DataDome can protect critical digital experiences.

You will own the technical motion across discovery, architecture discussions, demonstrations, proof-of-value exercises, security reviews, and technical close. You will work with security, engineering, infrastructure, and executive stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, leading customer conversations, and becoming a trusted technical advisor throughout the buying process.

DataDome delivers real-time bot and agent trust management, giving businesses complete visibility and control over all traffic—human, bot, or AI. Named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Bot And Agent Trust Management Q2 2026, DataDome is trusted by enterprises like Etsy, PayPal, and Soundcloud. Acting as a traffic control plane, DataDome's multi-layered AI engine leverages thousands of models and 5 trillion signals daily to analyze intent and stop fraud in under 2 milliseconds—letting legitimate users through seamlessly across websites, apps, APIs, and MCPs. Backed by a 24/7 SOC and expert threat researchers, DataDome stops 20k+ attacks every second. With 30+ global PoPs, and 80+ ready-made integrations, DataDome is a recognized Leader on G2 across several categories—delivering protection that outperforms.

What you will do

  • Own the technical strategy for mid-market and enterprise opportunities from discovery through technical close.
  • Understand customer business challenges, security priorities, application architecture, traffic flows, and success criteria.
  • Lead technical discovery and architecture discussions with engineering, security, infrastructure, and executive stakeholders.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling product demonstrations, workshops, technical presentations, and proof-of-value exercises.
  • Design and validate DataDome deployment approaches across web, mobile, API, CDN, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Guide prospects through technical evaluations, integrations, testing, security reviews, and production-readiness discussions.
  • Configure and analyze trial environments to validate DataDome’s detection and mitigation capabilities.
  • Analyze traffic, logs, detection outcomes, and customer requirements to recommend effective solutions.
  • Partner closely with Account Management, Sales, Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, and Marketing.
  • Help identify and overcome technical, security, and business objections.
  • Capture customer feedback and translate it into actionable input for Product and Engineering.
  • Contribute to Solutions Engineering enablement by creating reusable demos, technical content, discovery frameworks, and competitive guidance.
  • Help mentor other Solutions Engineers and raise the quality and consistency of the team’s customer-facing work.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles within SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, networking, developer tooling, or a related technology environment.
  • A track record of leading technical discovery, demonstrations, proof-of-value exercises, and security or architecture reviews.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, HTTP, APIs, networking, cloud architecture, CDNs, reverse proxies, and modern application infrastructure.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong consultative selling skills and experience handling technical, security, and business objections.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate with senior technical and executive stakeholders.

Candidates with 3+ years of relevant experience may also be considered if they have demonstrated ownership of complex enterprise evaluations, strong executive presence, and the ability to operate independently.

Bonus points for experience with

  • Cybersecurity, bot management, fraud prevention, WAF, DDoS protection, CDN, observability, or application performance.
  • Kibana, Elasticsearch, Grafana, or similar log analysis and observability tools.
  • Apache, Nginx, Varnish, IIS, Lambda@Edge, CloudFront, or similar web and edge technologies.
  • Mobile applications, APIs, or multi-cloud and multi-CDN environments.
  • Working with security, fraud, infrastructure, or digital experience teams.

What’s in it for you?

  • Fully remote position (US-based) with the flexibility to work from anywhere in+ $500 stipend to help you set up your ideal home workspace.
  • Health Benefits: We offer medical, dental, & vision insurance options to keep you feeling your best.
  • A $100 annual allowance is provided for a leisure activity of your choice in Sports.
  • Professional Development: #Weaimhigh is part of our DNA, therefore we have invested in an internal Learning and Development platform and offer the opportunity to request additional training and support via your manager.
  • Events & Team building: #We care and we have fun! We organize ****Annual Company-Offsite, Events, Drinks, Winter Party, Lunch & Learns and much more are part of our Culture
  • Parent Care: Gifts & care packages to celebrate growing families.
  • PTO: 20 paid time off days, 5 sick days and 2 floating holidays ****+ 12 national holidays.
  • 401 K eligibility + matching.

What are the next steps?

Our interview process is designed to give you the opportunity to meet key members of the team and demonstrate how you approach technical customer challenges.

  1. Introductory conversation with a Talent Acquisition Manager.
  2. Interview with the Solutions Engineering Manager, focused on your experience, technical depth, and customer approach.
  3. Practical case exercise involving a DataDome integration and customer-facing technical presentation.
  4. Final one-on-one conversation with our CEO.

The practical exercise will evaluate your ability to understand a technical product, explain how it is deployed, adapt to different stakeholders, and connect technical capabilities to customer outcomes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DataDome is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote (UK or Europe) Department: Product & Technology The OpportunityThis role is for someone who shapes what's worth building, designs it by building, and owns the result in production.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (UK or Europe) Department: Product & Technology

The Opportunity

This role is for someone who shapes what's worth building, designs it by building, and owns the result in production. You explore and prototype like a designer, then carry the strong ideas all the way to a shipped front-end - one craft, not two stages with a handoff between them.

When the same person designs and builds, there's no spec to hand off and no rebuild cycle: the work moves faster and the original intent survives. You'll sit in a product squad alongside software engineers who own the systems beneath the experience. They're accountable for whether it runs; you're accountable for what it is.

Most of what gets called "AI in product" is a button bolted onto an unchanged screen. Our client is building the opposite: experiences where the agent does the work and the human reviews, corrects, and authorises it. Knowing the difference - and being able to ship it - is the judgment we're hiring for.

What You'll Do

  • Explore and prototype to find the right answer. Most of what you make is for learning, not shipping. Production is where the right answer lands, not where it starts.
  • Carry features through to the production front-end. The design decision and the code are the same job, in the same hands.
  • Help frame what's worth building. Talk to users, pressure-test problems, and shape scope with your squad rather than waiting for a finished spec.
  • Build the supervisory surfaces of an agent-native platform: a triage queue an underwriter trusts at a glance, a confidence and citation pattern they can act on, a briefing that replaces a dashboard.
  • Use AI across the full loop - research, design, prototype, build, test - as the default way you work, applying real judgment to its output rather than trusting it.
  • Own the invisible craft: performance, accessibility, cross-device behaviour, and the responsiveness that makes an interface feel fast.

What We're Looking For

  • A builder who designs and ships front-end to production. You've owned a problem, made the call on what the experience should be, and shipped it yourself.
  • Design judgment and taste. When AI produces competent interfaces instantly, telling good from merely functional is the scarce skill.
  • Product instinct. You can cut scope without being told to and validate with real users rather than waiting for certainty.
  • Fluency in a modern web codebase, with AI tooling at every stage. You know AI's failure modes and can tell when output looks right but isn't. We care that you can ship and know when it's right, not which framework you came up on.
  • The ability to design data-rich, high-stakes interfaces for demanding professionals, and to converse credibly with seasoned insurance experts.

There's no single right background - strong candidates come from design, from engineering, and from places in between. If you design and you build and you can ship both well, we want to talk.

🚨 READ THIS FIRST

No Easy Apply. No AI.

This role is a health and medical video scriptwriter/storyteller with some interview-driven producing experience.

If your experience is more of a field producer / post producer hybrid with some medical scriptwriting/storytelling experience, consider applying for this role:

Why This Role Matters

The stories we tell influence:

· whether patients seek treatment

· how quickly clinicians adopt new technology

· how efficiently life-changing therapies reach the people who need them

The right fit for this role has experience in:

· understanding complex medical science quickly

· thinking critically

· connecting deeply with patients and clinicians

· turning those connections into creatively engaging, interview-driven videos

Who We Are…

We are an award-winning B2B creative video agency specializing in medtech and pharma. We create branded, documentary-style interview-driven video content aimed at clinicians, patients, and employees.

Our core focus is to help patients get access to the life-changing medical innovations they need through our engaging, authentic storytelling.

Our big, hairy, audacious goal? Help bring 150 life-changing medical innovations to patients who need them by 2034. And everyone on our team is deeply committed to the cause with team tenure ranging from four years to eleven years!

What This Role Actually Is

You are the internal subject matter expert and narrative lead on each project.

This is a client facing role where you develop and own the story end-to-end — from needs assessment, pre-script writing, pre-production, on set interviews, through post production and editing.

You are responsible for shaping the narrative before the shoot, directing and adapting it in real time during interviews, and ensuring the story comes together clearly and accurately in the final edit.

Approximately 60% of this role focuses on clinician-facing content and 40% on patient-centered storytelling.

You will:

· Listen to clients explain their business problem and learn as much as you can about the medical innovation and disease states they support

· Learn from clinicians who explain how they use the innovation, which features and benefits matter to them, and how it benefits patients.

· Interview patients with compassion and understanding of their unique situations

· Speak and write in a way that earns respect and understanding from clinicians as well as be able to switch gears/TOV into patient-facing storytelling, depending on the audience.

What We’re Really Looking For

You are someone who:

· Understands and has some end-to-end experience with the corporate/branded documentary film production process

· Can quickly learn complex medical and engineering innovation topics and explain them clearly

· Is both analytical and emotionally intelligent

· Is outgoing and warm, comfortable engaging in conversations with clients, experts, and patients alike

· Has demonstrated the ability write compelling interview-driven scripts.

· Thrives in ambiguity and can create structure

What You’ll Do

This role requires ownership across the full storytelling lifecycle:

1.) Learn Fast, Go Deep

  • Independently research and synthesize complex medical topics—often with limited public information—so you can engage clients and clinicians as a credible, informed partner from the very first conversation

2.) Discovery & Client Partnership

  • Lead early discovery conversations with clients to understand the business problem

  • Translate client goals into clear storytelling strategies

3. Shape the Story Concept Before Production

Work with clients to define:

  • audiences (clinicians/patients/employees)

  • messaging

  • creative strategy

  • Conduct in-depth pre-interviews to uncover emotional truth, narrative arcs, and key story beats—not just facts

  • In a pre-script, layout the story structure, dialogue and visual opportunities that will make an audience care

  • Work with production team to spec visuals (b-roll and graphics) and to ensure scripts can be executed by the production team within the budget and timeline

4. Lead Interviews On Set

  • Conduct on-camera interviews

  • Charm patients and clinicians to help them be their best on camera

  • Gather content that closely matches the pre-script, plus extra unexpected goodies

5. Create the Narrative

  • Turn interviews into video scripts that match the creative brief, balancing emotional truth, clinical accuracy, and regulatory guidelines

  • Work with producers and post-production team to ensure content stays on brief through final delivery

  • Support the editorial process to completion with your subject matter expertise, keeping the client’s interests in mind.

You May Come From

· Healthcare or science journalism (patient or clinician storytelling)

· Medical communications, MedTech or pharma marketing, or clinical communications

· Healthcare-focused PR (especially within MedTech or pharma)

· Non-fiction or interview-driven storytelling (with exposure to complex subject matter)

Must-Haves

· Experience working in healthcare, medtech, pharma, or clinical environments

· Proven ability to learn complex topics fast and explain them succinctly

· Strong writing + storytelling ability

· Experience interviewing patients and clinicians Meticulous communication and thinking—able to operate in highly regulated environments where precision, accuracy, and professionalism are non-negotiable

· High attention to detail

· Willingness to travel

Bonus Points

· Experience navigating legal, medical or compliance guidelines in regulated content environments

Not a Fit If Your Experience is Limited to:

· Creating content for broad, B2C audiences rather than crafting stories for highly targeted, expert audiences with defined needs

· Scripted narrative content

· Reality TV

What Success Looks Like

· You can hold and navigate depth across multiple complex projects simultaneously—quickly getting up to speed, retaining critical details, and switching between projects without losing accuracy or context

· Concepts are strategically grounded and well-researched, using clinical evidence, audience insight, and thoughtful pre-interviews to support the client’s goals

· Content remains on brief throughout the project lifecycle, accurately reflecting the client’s messaging strategy and objectives from concept through final delivery

· Pre-interviews and interviews are conducted with professionalism and high emotional intelligence, resulting in authentic, engaging stories that align with both patient experience and client intent

· Scripts clearly and effectively deliver on messaging targets, integrating clinical accuracy and patient/clinician perspective while staying true to approved positioning and tone

· Patients and clinicians feel respected and supported, and clinician audiences find the content credible, relevant, and worth their time
